title: Knee Arthroscopy and Meniscectomy
description: Medicare coverage criteria for diagnostic and therapeutic knee arthroscopy, including partial meniscectomy and loose body removal. Requires mechanical locking/catching symptoms, MRI confirmation of unstable meniscal tear, and absence of advanced Kellgren-Lawrence Grade 4 tricompartmental osteoarthritis.

criteria.name: Documented Mechanical Symptoms (Locking or Catching)
criteria.description: Physical examination and clinical documentation confirming mechanical knee symptoms such as true joint locking, catching, or giving way.
criteria.clinical_intent: Establish mechanical dysfunction rather than generalized ache
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

criteria.name: Unstable Meniscal Tear Confirmed on MRI
criteria.description: Diagnostic MRI confirming displaced, bucket-handle, flap, or complex unstable meniscal tear correlating with clinical exam.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

criteria.name: Advanced End-Stage Osteoarthritis Exclusion (Debridement Only)
criteria.description: Arthroscopic debridement or lavage performed solely for advanced end-stage osteoarthritis (Kellgren-Lawrence Grade 4) without acute mechanical tear.
criteria.clinical_intent: Statutory exclusion of arthroscopy for uncomplicated severe osteoarthritis
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

cms_reference.notes: No active NCD or LCD exists in MCD. Covered under Medicare reasonable and necessary standard for orthopedic arthroscopy.
cms_reference.authority: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A)
cms_reference.citation: Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A); Medicare Claims Processing Manual Chapter 12
